shells.name: Buyer portal
regions: Skip link
Sandbox band (sandbox only), above everything
Phones/tablets only: top bar with brand (seal, 'TshepoVet', organisation legal name) and a 'Menu' button

Desktop (lg and up): sticky left sidebar, collapsible (Q1). pages.name: Know who you are paying.
pages.purpose: A visitor learns what a TshepoVet check answers and starts an account or looks at prices.
regions: Hero (two columns on large screens): h1 'Know who you are paying.', lead paragraph, buttons 'Create an account' and 'See the prices', line giving the company-check price and 'no subscription'
Specimen passport beside the hero: a sample Verified Vendor Passport for 'Specimen Trading (Pty) Ltd', overprinted 'Specimen', tilted slightly
Section 'What one check answers': 5 question/answer pairs in two columns (registered and still in business; directors; tax compliant today; B-BBEE level; can its driver drive your load)
Section 'How it works' (tinted band): 3 numbered steps 'Add a supplier', 'Check it, or let it onboard itself', 'Hear before anything lapses'
Two columns: 'Invited by a customer?' with links 'Sign in as a supplier' and 'Check a printed passport'; 'For developers' with three API endpoints in mono and 'Read the API documentation'
states: Company-check price is read from the API at render time

pages.name: Pricing
pages.purpose: A visitor sees what each check and module costs from a prepaid rand wallet.
regions: Header: h1 'Pricing', paragraph on topping up a wallet in rand, no subscription, VAT rate
Callout 'This is the sandbox' (sandbox only): pretend money, sample data, same prices
Section 'Checks': price list of 4 rows, name and description left, price and unit right: Company check; Company check, fresh from the bureau; Driving licence check; Monitoring (a supplier a month)
Note: onboarding costs a supplier nothing, checks are charged to the inviting customer
Section 'Modules' (only when modules exist): monthly price rows with description and 'Not available yet: reason'
Buttons: 'Create an account', 'Read the API documentation'
states: Prices and modules come from the API

pages.name: Words we use
pages.purpose: A reader looks up an abbreviation or compliance term in plain words.
regions: Header: h1 'Words we use', description 'South African compliance has its own vocabulary. Here is what each term means, in plain words.'

Definition list, A to Z, divided by rules: each term in bold with its expansion in brackets, then a plain explanation (AVS, B-BBEE, CIDB, CIPC, COIDA, CSD, DSR, EME, KYB, PAIA, POPIA, PrDP, QSE, SARS, TCS, VAT)
Each entry carries an anchor id (the term in lower case) so it can be linked directly

pages.name: Privacy notice / Terms of use
pages.purpose: A reader reads the privacy notice (/legal/privacy) or the terms of use (/legal/terms).
regions: Header: h1 the document title ('Privacy notice' or 'Terms of use')
Callout (caution) 'Draft': 'This text is waiting for legal review and may change before TshepoVet goes live.'
Sections, each an h2 with paragraphs. Privacy: Who we are; What we process, and why; How long we keep it; Where it is kept; Your rights. Terms: The sandbox; Your account; Checks; Charges
states: Only 'privacy' and 'terms' exist; any other value is a 404

pages.name: <supplier legal name> (Verified Vendor Passport)
pages.access: Anyone with the link (not indexed); shown only while the supplier keeps it published
pages.purpose: A buyer opens or prints a supplier's published Verified Vendor Passport.
regions: Passport sheet header: guilloche band, large verified seal, 'Verified Vendor Passport', h1 legal name, registration number in mono

Facts grid (only the fields the supplier chose): Status on the CIPC register (stamp), Tax compliance (SARS) stamp with PIN validity and check date, VAT, B-BBEE level with evidence validity, Directors (initials), Verified date
Sheet footer: QR code that opens this page, verification code in groups of four, how to check a printed copy
Actions (hidden when printing): 'Print or save as PDF' button, 'Check a printed copy' link
Disclaimer: the facts describe the company on the verified date
states: Withdrawn: sheet with 'Withdrawn' stamp and h1 'This passport was withdrawn'
API unreachable: caution callout 'The passport could not be loaded'

pages.name: Check a supplier passport
pages.purpose: A buyer types the code from a printed passport to see whether it is genuine and current.
regions: Header: h1 'Check a supplier passport', paragraph explaining the printed passport and its code
Form: 'Verification code' field (mono; hint 'Printed at the bottom of the passport, in groups of four'), 'Check the code' button

Result callout (live region): 'Genuine and current', 'Genuine, but out of date', 'Genuine, but the passport was withdrawn' or 'TshepoVet did not issue this code'; 'Open the current passport' link when there is one
states: Validation error for a short code

pages.name: Supplier onboarding for <buyer>
pages.access: Anyone holding a valid onboarding link (token in the URL fragment, kept in sessionStorage for the tab); links come from a buyer's 'Invite to onboard' email
pages.purpose: A supplier invited by a buyer agrees to the checks and adds its company, identity, B-BBEE, bank and tax details step by step.
regions: Header: h1 'Supplier onboarding for {buyer}', supplier legal name with registration number
Steps bar: Agree, Company, Identity, B-BBEE, Bank, Tax, Review (numbered, current step highlighted)

Step sheet 'Before you start': what happens to the information, link to the privacy notice, sandbox callout, 'Your full name', 'Your role at the company' (optional), consent checkbox, 'Agree and continue'
Step sheet 'Is this your company?': registered name, status, directors as the CIPC register has them; 'Yes, this is my company' / 'No, something is wrong'

Step sheets 'Your identity document' and 'B-BBEE evidence': retake/wrong-document callouts, sandbox radio list of sample documents (live: 'Uploads open when TshepoVet goes live'), 'Add the document'; B-BBEE also 'My customer does not need this'
Step sheet 'Bank details': Bank select, Account number, Account type radios; 'Add bank details' / 'Skip for now'
Step sheet 'Tax compliance': Income tax reference number, Tax compliance status PIN; 'Check with SARS' / 'Skip for now'

Step sheet 'Check and submit': stamp per item (Company, Identity document, B-BBEE, Bank details, Tax compliance); 'Publish a Verified Vendor Passport' checkbox for directors, otherwise an info callout; 'Submit to {buyer}'
Done sheet 'Submitted': seal, '{buyer} has your details', link to sign in as a supplier (directors only)
states: Expired or withdrawn link: 'This link has expired or was withdrawn'
Company disputed: caution callout, flow stops
Error callout on a failed step
Sandbox: sample documents instead of uploads

pages.name: Sign in to TshepoVet
pages.purpose: A buyer user signs in with email and password, then an authenticator code if two-step verification is on.
regions: Header: h1 'Sign in to TshepoVet'
Error summary and problem callout, with 'Send the confirmation email again' (unverified email) or 'Reset your password' (wrong password / locked)
Form: Email address, Password with show/hide button, full-width 'Sign in'
Links: 'Forgot your password?', 'New to TshepoVet? Create an account'
Second step on the same page: h1 'Two-step verification', 'Code' field (or 'Recovery code'), 'Sign in', toggle 'I cannot use my authenticator app' / 'Use a code from the app instead'
states: Expired challenge returns to the password step
After sign-in goes to ?next= inside /app, or /app/mfa-setup

pages.name: Create your TshepoVet account
pages.purpose: A new buyer organisation creates its workspace and owner account.
regions: Header: h1 'Create your TshepoVet account', 'Your organisation gets its own workspace, a wallet for checks, and you as its owner.'
Error summary and problem callout

Form: Organisation (registered name), Your full name, Work email address, Password with show/hide and hint, checkbox 'I accept the terms of use and have read the privacy notice', full-width 'Create account'
Link: 'Already have an account? Sign in'
After submit: h1 'Check your email', 'Nothing arrived?' info callout, 'Back to sign in'

pages.name: Confirm your email address
pages.access: Anyone with the emailed link (token in fragment), or ?resend=email from sign-in
pages.purpose: A new user confirms their email address, or asks for a new confirmation link.
regions: While checking the link: spinner 'Confirming your email address'
Success: h1 'Email address confirmed', 'You can sign in now.', 'Sign in' button
Expired link or resend: h1 'This link has expired or was already used' (or 'Confirm your email address'), Email address field, 'Send a new link'
After resending: h1 'Check your email' with 'Nothing arrived?' callout and 'Back to sign in'

pages.name: Reset your password
pages.purpose: A user asks for a password-reset link by email.
regions: Header: h1 'Reset your password', 'Enter the email address you sign in with...'
Form: Email address, full-width 'Send reset link'
Link: 'Back to sign in'
After submit: h1 'Check your email' with 'Nothing arrived?' callout

pages.name: Choose a new password
pages.access: Anyone with the emailed reset link (token in fragment)
pages.purpose: A user sets a new password from the reset email.
regions: Header: h1 'Choose a new password'
Problem callout with 'Ask for a new link'
Form: New password with show/hide and hint, full-width 'Change password'
Done: h1 'Password changed', 'You were signed out everywhere...', 'Sign in' button
states: No token: h1 'This link is not complete' with 'Ask for a new link'

pages.name: Join <organisation>
pages.access: Anyone with a team invitation link (token in fragment)
pages.purpose: An invited colleague sets their name and password and joins the organisation.
regions: Header: h1 'Join {organisation}', 'You were invited as a {role}. You will sign in with {email}.'
Error summary and problem callout
Form: Your full name, Choose a password with show/hide and hint, full-width 'Join {organisation}'
states: Expired: h1 'This invitation has expired or was already used'

pages.name: Good to see you, <first name> (Overview)
pages.access: Signed-in buyer (no page guard; the nav item needs suppliers:read)
pages.purpose: A buyer sees this month's checks, suppliers, expiries and wallet at a glance.
regions: Header: h1 'Good to see you, {first name}', organisation name, 'Run a check' button (checks:run)
Callouts: 'Your wallet is running low' with 'Top up the wallet' (wallet:read); '{n} things need attention' with 'See the alerts'

Section 'This month': 4 stat tiles - Checks run (% verified, 'See all checks'), Suppliers (approved / in progress), Expiring in 30 days ('See the calendar'), Wallet available (held amount, 'Open the wallet')
Sheet 'Latest checks': list of supplier link, check type and time, outcome stamp; empty state 'No checks yet' with 'Run your first check'
Sheet 'Recent activity' (audit:read) with 'Audit log' link: action, actor, time

pages.name: Suppliers
pages.purpose: A buyer searches, filters and opens the suppliers they pay, and adds new ones.
regions: Header: h1 'Suppliers', description, buttons 'Add a supplier' (suppliers:write) and 'Run a check' (checks:run)
Filter bar: Search (name, registration number or your reference), Status select, Risk select, Monitoring select, 'Views' menu (saved views, 'Save this view', delete a view), 'Export CSV'
Table (sortable): Supplier (name, registration number, your reference), Status stamp, Last check (outcome stamp and time), Risk, Monitoring (with 'Payments locked' stamp), Next expiry
Pagination, 25 per page
Dialog 'Add a supplier': Registration number, Your reference (optional), Industry; 'already on your list' callout with link
Dialog 'Save this view': Name
states: Empty: 'No suppliers yet...' or 'No suppliers match these filters.'
Filters, sort and page kept in the URL
No permission: 'You cannot open this page'

pages.name: <supplier legal name>
pages.access: Signed-in buyer with suppliers:read (changes need suppliers:write, monitoring:manage, checks:run; audit tab audit:read)
pages.purpose: A buyer reviews everything known about one supplier and approves, monitors, invites or locks payments to it.
regions: Header: breadcrumbs Suppliers > name; h1 legal name; status stamp, latest outcome stamp, registration number; buttons 'Run a check', 'Invite to onboard', 'Change status' menu (Approve, Send for review, Reject, Suspend, Offboard), 'Edit'
Callout 'Payments to this supplier are locked' (when locked)
Tabs: Facts, People, B-BBEE and bank, Documents, Onboarding, Monitoring, Checks, Audit trail (audit:read)

Facts tab: 'The company' record (registered and trading name, registration no, entity type, CIPC status, incorporated, annual return due, VAT, CSD) and 'Your relationship' (status, risk, your reference, industry, approved, added)
People tab: 'Directors and members' table and 'Beneficial owners' table; B-BBEE and bank tab: 'B-BBEE status' record and 'Bank accounts' (last four digits, verified stamp)
Documents tab: 'Documents' and 'Licences and permits' tables; Onboarding tab: 'Onboarding invitations' table (Sent to, Status, Sent, Link works until, Withdraw)

Monitoring tab: 'Continuous monitoring' (Start/Stop monitoring, Lock/Unlock/Override payments) and 'What expires when' list; Checks tab: list of checks with outcome stamps; Audit trail tab: timeline with 'Show older entries'

Dialogs: 'Invite the supplier to onboard', '{Action} this supplier?' with Reason, 'Edit supplier details' (reference, risk rating, industry), 'Start monitoring' (accounting lock, consent), lock/unlock with Reason, 'Withdraw the invitation?'

pages.name: Checks
pages.purpose: A buyer browses every company and driver check run through the portal or the API.
regions: Header: h1 'Checks', description, 'Run a check' button (checks:run)

Filter bar: Search (supplier name, registration number or reference), Type select (All checks / Company / Driver), Result select (Any result, Verified, Verified with warnings, Failed checks, Not found, Could not verify)
Table (sortable): Checked (name or subject, check type), Result stamp, When, By, Cost (or 'Not charged')
Pagination, 25 per page
states: Empty: 'No checks match. Run one: the result appears here.'

pages.name: Run a check
pages.purpose: A buyer runs a paid company or driver check from the wallet.
regions: Header: breadcrumbs Checks > Run a check, h1 'Run a check'
Radio 'What do you want to check?': A company / A driver, each with its price

Company form: Registration number; 'What to check' checkboxes (Registration always, Directors, VAT registration, Tax compliance with SARS); VAT number, Income tax reference and TCS PIN fields when ticked; 'How fresh must the answer be?' radios; 'Keep monitoring this supplier'; Your reference
Driver form: Driver's ID number, Licence number (optional), Surname (optional), licence code checkboxes, PrDP category checkboxes (G, P, D)
Consent fieldset when needed: agreement checkbox, 'Where the evidence is kept'
Price line, or caution callout 'Your wallet does not have enough for this check'; submit 'Run the check for R...'
Side panel (sticky on wide screens): 'Your wallet' available balance with 'Top up the wallet'; sandbox callout listing test-data numbers
states: Submit disabled when the wallet is short

pages.name: <supplier name or check subject>
pages.purpose: A buyer reads the result of one check, part by part, with anything to act on.
regions: Header: breadcrumbs Checks > name; h1 supplier name (or 'Company {reg}' / 'Driver {id}'); outcome stamp, check type, requester and exact time; 'Open the supplier' button
Callout 'Still checking' while processing (page polls every 2 seconds)
Sheet 'One thing to look at' / '{n} things to look at' listing risk flags with advice, or callout 'Nothing to look at'

Grid of one sheet per part (Registration (CIPC), Directors, VAT registration, Tax compliance (SARS), Driving licence, Professional driving permit, Identity): source and as-of date, status stamp, result facts or director list, warnings
Billing line: 'Charged R... (excluding VAT) from the wallet.' or 'Not charged.'

pages.name: Monitoring
pages.purpose: A buyer sees what is lapsing, what has lapsed and whose payments are locked.
regions: Header: h1 'Monitoring', description
4 stat tiles: Monitored suppliers, Expiring in 30 days, Expired, Payments locked
Sheet 'Needs attention': alerts (supplier link, what lapses and when, stamp '{n} days left' / 'Expired' / 'Locked'), or an all-clear sentence
Sheet 'Expiry calendar': three-month window label, 'Earlier' / 'Later' buttons, items grouped by month (date, supplier link, what expires)
Sheet 'Monitored suppliers' table: Supplier, Monitored since, Accounting lock, Payments stamp, Next expiry; empty state 'No suppliers are monitored yet' with 'Go to suppliers'

pages.name: Modules
pages.access: Any signed-in buyer (switching needs settings:manage; the scorecard needs modules:use)
pages.purpose: A buyer turns paid monthly modules on or off.
regions: Header: h1 'Modules', description about monthly charges from the wallet
Grid of module sheets (2 columns): name, stamp On / 'Ends {date}' / Off, description, '{price} a month, excluding VAT', 'Not available yet' callout
Sheet buttons: 'Open the scorecard' (B-BBEE module when on), 'Turn on' / 'Turn off' / 'Keep it on'
Confirm dialogs: 'Turn on {module}?' (first month charged now), 'Turn off {module}?' (stays on to month end), 'Keep {module} on?'

pages.name: Preferential procurement (B-BBEE scorecard)
pages.purpose: A buyer records spend per supplier and sees how much counts towards its own B-BBEE scorecard.
regions: Header: breadcrumbs Modules > B-BBEE scorecard, h1 'Preferential procurement', description
Sheet 'Measurement period': From and To date fields (default March to February)
4 stat tiles: Measured spend, Recognised spend (% of measured), Spend with EMEs and QSEs, Unverified spend
Sheet 'Targets that count ownership': spend with 51% black-owned, 30% black women-owned and empowering suppliers
Sheet 'By supplier' table: Supplier, Level, Spend, Recognised at, Recognised spend, Evidence stamp
Sheet 'Record spend' form: Supplier, Amount in rand, From, To, Description, 'Record spend' (empty state 'Add suppliers first')
Sheet 'Spend lines in this period': list with amount and 'Delete' (confirm 'Delete this spend line?')
states: Reached only from the Modules page while the B-BBEE module is on

pages.name: Wallet
pages.access: Signed-in buyer with wallet:read (top-up and warning level need wallet:topup)
pages.purpose: A buyer checks the prepaid balance, tops it up and downloads tax invoices.
regions: Header: h1 'Wallet', description, 'Top up' button

Two sheets side by side: 'Balance' (available now, Balance, Held for checks in progress, Warn me below with 'Change', Status; low-balance callout) and 'Held right now' (company/driver holds with amounts)
Sheet 'Movements': Show filter, 'Export CSV', table When / What / Details / Amount, pagination (20)
Sheet 'Top-ups and tax invoices': each top-up with invoice number, time, provider, 'Download the tax invoice (PDF)', paid amount with credit + VAT
Dialog 'Top up the wallet': amount radios R500, R1 000, R2 500, R10 000, Another amount; VAT breakdown; 'Pay R...'; then 'Wallet topped up' with credit, VAT, paid, invoice number, new balance
Dialog 'Warn me when the balance is low': Amount in rand

pages.name: Developers
pages.purpose: A developer makes API keys, adds webhook endpoints and tries the API with a test key.
regions: Header: h1 'Developers', description with 'Read the API documentation' link
Tabs: API keys, Webhooks, Try the API
API keys tab: sheet 'API keys' with 'Make a key'; table Name, Key starts, Kind (Test/Live), Last used, State stamp, 'Revoke'
Webhooks tab: sheet 'Webhook endpoints' with 'Add endpoint'; list of URLs (link to the endpoint page), event count, failures, Sending/Paused stamp; code block 'Check a signature (Node.js)'
Try the API tab: sheet 'Call the API' (Test key, Scenario select, Registration number, 'Send request') beside the response code block
Dialogs: 'Make an API key' (Name, Kind) then 'Your new key' secret reveal; 'Add a webhook endpoint' (Address, Description, 'Events to send' checkboxes) then signing secret; 'Revoke {key}?' confirm

pages.name: <webhook endpoint URL>
pages.purpose: A developer watches deliveries to one webhook endpoint, pauses it, rotates its secret or resends events.
regions: Header: breadcrumbs Developers > Webhook endpoint; h1 endpoint URL in mono; Sending/Paused stamp; buttons 'Pause'/'Resume' and 'Rotate the secret'
Sheet 'New signing secret' with secret reveal (only after rotating)
Sheet 'Deliveries' table: Event, Sent, Result stamp (Delivered, Retrying, Gave up, Queued), Answer (HTTP status or error), Attempts, 'Send again'; pagination (20)
Confirm dialog 'Make a new signing secret?' (both secrets sign for 24 hours)

pages.name: Team
pages.access: Signed-in buyer with team:read (changes need team:manage)
pages.purpose: An administrator invites colleagues, changes their roles and removes them.
regions: Header: h1 'Team', description, 'Invite someone' button (team:manage)
Sheet 'Members' table: Name with email and '(you)', Role (inline select for managers), Two-step verification stamp, Last signed in, 'Remove'
Sheet 'Waiting to accept' (only when invitations exist): email, role, expiry, 'Withdraw'
Sheet 'What each role may do': Owner, Admin, Compliance officer, Procurement, AP clerk, Viewer with a hint and permission count
Dialogs: 'Invite someone' (Email address, Role), confirm 'Remove {name}?', confirm 'Withdraw the invitation to {email}?'

pages.name: Compliance
pages.access: Signed-in buyer with compliance:read (changes need compliance:manage)
pages.purpose: A compliance officer shows POPIA records: consents, data-subject requests, privacy notices and the record of processing.
regions: Header: h1 'Compliance', POPIA description, 'Audit log' button (audit:read)
Tabs: Consents, Data-subject requests, Privacy notices, What we process

Consents tab: Show filter (All consents, Still in force, Fully withdrawn); table Who agreed, For (purposes with lawful basis, struck through when withdrawn), How, When, 'Record withdrawal'; pagination
Data-subject requests tab: sheet 'DSRs' with 'Log a request'; Show filter (Open, Closed, All); rows with request type and requester, received/due dates, status, days-left stamp, 'Update'

Privacy notices tab: one sheet per notice version with channel, dates and text; What we process tab: 'Record of processing' table (Processing, Lawful basis, Information, Special information, Kept for)

Dialogs: 'Record a withdrawal of consent' (purposes, how they told you), 'Log a data-subject request' (They asked to, Who asked, Notes), 'Update the request' (Status, identity confirmed, What was done)

pages.name: Audit log
pages.purpose: A compliance officer reads every change made in the organisation and checks the hash chain is intact.
regions: Header: breadcrumbs Compliance > Audit log, h1 'Audit log', description of the fingerprint chain, 'Check the chain' button
Result callout: 'The chain is intact' (entries checked) or 'The chain is broken' (entry number)
Filter bar: 'Action starts with' text field, 'Done by' select (Anyone, People, API keys, TshepoVet, TshepoVet support)
Table: When (exact), What happened, Who, On (entity type), From (IP)
Paging buttons 'Newer entries' / 'Older entries'

pages.name: Settings
pages.purpose: An administrator edits the organisation's details and organisation-wide preferences.
regions: Header: h1 'Settings', description

Sheet 'Organisation': form Registered name, Registration number, VAT number, Information officer's email, checkbox 'We are a public-sector buyer', 'Save changes' (read-only list for users without settings:manage)
Sheet 'How TshepoVet works for you': switches 'Ask for consent on every check', 'Email me when the wallet runs low', 'Email me before documents expire'

pages.name: Your account
pages.purpose: A user manages their own two-step verification, password, theme and signed-in devices.
regions: Header: h1 'Your account', '{name}, {email}'
Sheet 'You': Name, Email address, Role, Organisation; theme switch (Light, Dark, Device)
Sheet 'Two-step verification' with On/Off stamp: 'New recovery codes' and 'Turn off' (not offered to owners/admins), or 'Turn on two-step verification'
Sheet 'Password': Current password, New password, 'Change password'
Sheet 'Where you are signed in': 'Sign out everywhere else' button, sessions list (device, IP, last active, 'Sign out')
Dialogs: 'New recovery codes' (password, then codes with 'Copy the codes'), 'Turn off two-step verification?' (password and app code)

pages.name: Set up two-step verification
pages.access: Any signed-in buyer; forced for roles that require it (session stage mfa_setup)
pages.purpose: A user links an authenticator app and saves recovery codes.
regions: Header: h1 'Set up two-step verification', description (forced users are told their role requires it)
Error callout
Sheet '1. Get an authenticator app'
Sheet '2. Add TshepoVet to it': QR code and the setup key in groups of four
Sheet '3. Enter the code it shows': 6-digit code field, 'Turn on two-step verification'
'Sign out instead' with confirm dialog (forced users only)

Link: 'Buying from suppliers? Sign in to the buyer portal'
After submit: h1 'Check your email' with 'Nothing arrived?' callout
states: Link token in fragment: spinner 'Signing you in', then /supplier
Used/expired link: h1 'This link has expired or was already used'

pages.name: <company legal name> (Your company's record)
pages.access: Supplier session (magic-link sign-in); without the session cookie redirected to /supplier/sign-in
pages.purpose: A supplier director controls the public passport, consents given to customers and POPIA requests to them.

Sheet 'Customers who hold your details' table: Customer, Where it stands, Monitoring you, Since

Sheet 'Your requests to customers' with 'Send a request': table Request, To, Status, Sent, Answer due

states: 'Your company has not been verified yet' callout

pages.name: Staff sign-in

Code step: '6-digit code' field, 'Continue'
Enrol step (staff without two-step yet): h1 'Set up two-step verification', QR code, setup key, '6-digit code', 'Turn on two-step verification'

Callout 'This is the sandbox' (sandbox only): mail held in the outbox, WhatsApp in the simulator, mock bureau

4 stat tiles: Waiting for review (documents, WhatsApp hand-offs), Open data requests (overdue, due within 7 days), Tenants (suspended), Checks in the last 24 hours (failed, running); links only for roles that can open them

pages.name: Review queue

Dialog '{document}: {supplier}': Decision radios (Accept it / Reject it), Reason, 'Record the decision'
states: Other roles: 'Your staff role cannot open this page'

pages.access: Staff with role support or admin; suspend/reinstate admin only
